page_title: Notchi for Mac — notes, reminders, AI, and agents

summary.name: Notchi
summary.one_liner: Notchi is a free, open-source Mac app that turns the screen notch into an input for notes, reminders, AI answers, and coding-agent tasks.
use_cases: quick notes typed into the notch
creating reminders from a line of text
asking an AI a quick question from the menu bar
handing a project to a coding agent
reviewing what data an AI app sends
viewing numbers as charts in AI answers
summary.what_it_does:
Notchi lets you type into the Mac notch to save a note, create a reminder, or ask an AI a question. Lines containing a time are sent to Reminders. The AI can search the web when needed, keeps the last answer visible for follow-ups, and keeps all questions in one unified thread with memory. Numbers can be shown as charts. It can also hand a project to Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor, and it has a Settings → Audit view listing every request it sends. Chats and memory are stored locally, and users can connect their own model provider key directly.</what_it_does>
